## Summary

The change stores telephone numbers as digits-only and normalizes before the uniqueness check. Three edits:

1. **`ClinicServiceImpl.saveOwner`** — normalize the telephone to digits-only at the start of the method (`owner.setTelephone(normalizeTelephone(...))`), so the stored value and the JSON returned in the `telephone` field are digits-only.

2. **`ClinicServiceImpl.isSameOwner`** — switched the duplicate check to `normalizeTelephone(...)` (strips everything but digits) instead of the whitespace/case `normalize(...)`, so `(613) 555-0100` and `6135550100` collide. 3. **`openapi.yml`** — relaxed the `telephone` request-DTO pattern from `^[0-9]*$` to `^[0-9 ()-]*$` so formatted input passes request validation and reaches the service to be normalized. (The `Owner` entity's own `^[0-9]{10}$` constraint still holds, since normalization runs before persist.)
